description: Dependency-update policy for docker-autoheal. See docs/DEPENDENCY_MANAGEMENT.md for the full explanation of these choices.

packageRules.description: Automerge routine, low-risk updates (patch/minor version bumps, digest refreshes, and Renovate's own version/digest 'pin' PRs) once all required CI checks on the PR have passed. GitHub's native auto-merge is used (platformAutomerge above), so this can never complete while a required status check is failing or pending.
Never automerge major version upgrades. These always get a normal PR for manual review, so they stay clearly distinguishable from routine updates.

Pin Docker image tags to an immutable SHA256 digest as well as their human-readable tag/version (image:VERSION@sha256:DIGEST), for every Dockerfile and docker-compose image Renovate finds, wherever the registry supports digests. GitHub Actions get the equivalent treatment (owner/repo@<commit-sha> # vX.Y.Z) via the helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests preset extended above.

tommye123/docker-autoheal (referenced in docker-compose.yml) is this project's own published image, not a third-party dependency - see the comment next to that reference. Renovate should not manage it.
